title: Refundable-children query also returns the earlier refund, so a repeated refund reverses the refund

bugs.anchor: -- Case 2: The transaction is a child and is APPLIED or VOID
bugs.note: A refund is recorded as an APPLIED child of the transaction it refunds, and the query picks up every APPLIED child. A second refund call of X selects the refund of X as well, which has not been refunded yet, so it gets reversed and the original payment is applied again while the API answers 409.
